description: Bank the E116 late freeze under the H4.9 acceptance rule. The code is E116 unchanged (82e6219: stem and group 1 detached from 85% of samples, all renorm x freeze variants warmed in build). Step 1, untimed: run E116 through the benchmark's own trial code on seeds 103-202 in one fresh process, which brings E116 to ~198 distinct trajectories. Compare its pooled mean with the pooled 200-trajectory E100 baseline (E113 arms A+B, H4.6.2; SE ~0.026 pp). Step 2: score E116 code up to 3 times. Stop at the first scored row >= 0.753. Log per-trial prepare/train times in every scored run to explain the 4.306 s scored vs 4.263 s dev gap (e.g. trial-1 first use of the frozen variant). Bank E116 as the tip only if its population mean is >= 0.7518 and a scored row >= 0.753 appears within 3 attempts. Otherwise E100 stays the tip and the freeze needs funding (I_b / H10.1.2).
